intro.name: Paphawit Ngamchaliew
intro.title: Senior Software Engineer
intro.summary: Senior Software Engineer developing a new flagship product at LSEG to deliver an enhanced user experience. Experienced in high-performance financial applications, application modernization, and cloud infrastructure.

technologies.details: Angular2, Next.js, React.js, Express.js, Node.js, TailwindCSS, Jasmine

details: Develop a new flagship product at LSEG, designed to deliver an enhanced user experience.
Lead development and maintenance of core products on LSEG’s high-performance financial data platform.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align technical strategy and delivery plans with business priorities.
Modernize application architecture to improve performance, scalability, and maintainability.
Optimize application performance through Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) improvements and dynamic loading.
Use AI-assisted workflows to automate repetitive development tasks and improve engineering efficiency.
Translate user feedback into features that improve everyday workflows.
Maintained and enhanced core products for LSEG’s financial data platform, working closely with QA and business stakeholders.
Migrated the application from Angular 9 to Angular 20 to improve maintainability and performance.
Delivered performance improvements including a 10% reduction in CPU usage and a feature supporting 9× the previous data size.
Researched and implemented Web Workers, WebAssembly, and Node.js server-side calculations.
Automated deployment and code analysis in CI/CD pipelines; planned releases and mentored new team members.
Developed and containerized applications, with deployment managed through ArgoCD.
Migrated on-premises infrastructure to AWS EC2 and ECR for improved reliability and scalability.
Designed a microservices architecture for the 42Bangkok Registration Platform.
Introduced modern web technologies including Next.js, and promoted maintainable engineering practices.
Led teams of 3–5 photographers and videographers for events, advertising, and concerts.
Managed client requirements, production schedules, and delivery; introduced cloud storage to streamline collaboration.
